notes: gemma classification prompt: 'Classify the image into exactly one of the following categories: 1121, 1509, 1637, 1718, 1728, BAS_370, CSR_30, DHBT_3, PB1, PB_6, Unknown. Respond with a JSON object containing a single key "label" whose value is the single best-matching category name, exactly as written above (one of: 1121, 1509, 1637, 1718, 1728, BAS_370, CSR_30, DHBT_3, PB1, PB_6, Unknown), and nothing else.'. Generation sampling params (vLLM): {'temperature': 1.0, 'top_p': 0.95, 'top_k': 64}, max_tokens=256, batch_size=32. Predicted labels are extracted from a JSON {"label": ...} response and matched to the dataset's category names by exact string match only (see parse_predicted_label); samples with no exact match are excluded from metrics (see metrics['skipped_samples']). f1/precision/recall are macro-averaged multiclass metrics (see compute_classification_metrics).
